capabilities.body: OpenAmer hyehyɛ adwuma, de nnwinnade ankasa — ahyɛdeɛ mfɛnsere, intanɛt hwɛfo, fael ne koodu — yɛ, na ɛkora nea ɛyɛɛ adwuma no so.
capabilities.title: Ɔboafo a ɔne wo dwene

capabilities.body: Nkɔmmɔ, nkaeɛ ne nhwɛsoɔ wɔ saa afiri yi so. Wɔmfa biribiara nkɔ intanɛt so gye sɛ wobisa.
capabilities.title: W'afiri, wo data

capabilities.body: Kasa 186, emu biara wɔ atwerɛ a wotumi kenkan mu. App no kratafa a edi kan no bisa nea wopɛ.
capabilities.title: Wo kasa, sɛnea ɛsɛ

capabilities.body: Wɔkora nimdeɛ a ɛfiri adwuma no mu ba no so, enti mpɛn dodoɔ a wode di dwuma no, mpɛn dodow no ara na da biara adwuma gye berɛ kakra.
capabilities.title: Tumi a ɛnyin

help: Hwɛ sɛ afiri yi tumi kɔ intanɛt so.
Yɛ ahyehyɛ no bio — wɔrenyɛ anammɔn a wɔawie no bio.
Sɛ ɛdi nkoguo mprenu a, bue kyerɛwtohɔ no; nkyerɛwdeɛ a etwa to no kyerɛ anammɔn no.
failure.lead: Wɔansan nsakraeɛ biara akyi komm — OpenAmer gyina baabi a ɛgyinaeɛ no, enti sɛ wosan yɛ a, ɛtoa so firi hɔ.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer da so wɔ nea na ɛwɔ hɔ kane no so na ɛkɔ so yɛ adwuma. Wɔansesa biribiara fã nko ara.
failure.title: Ahyehyɛ no anwie

language.lead: Ahyehyɛ no bɛtoa so wɔ kasa a wobɛpaw wɔ ha no mu. Wubetumi asesa no akyiri yi wɔ app no mu.
language.title: Paw wo kasa

progress.lead: Ahyehyɛ a wɔyɛ pɛnkoro: OpenAmer retwe nea ɛhia na ɛrehyehyɛ afiri yi. Sɛ wobue no akyiri yi a, ɛrentwa saa anammɔn yi bio.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer resi nea na ɛwɔ hɔ kane no ananmu. Wo dwumadie, nkaeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ rensesa.
progress.title: Wɔrehyehyɛ OpenAmer

stages.bootstrap-marker: Wɔrehyɛ no agyirae sɛ wɔawie de gu so
stages.dependencies: Wɔde nneɛma a Python hia regu so
stages.node-deps: Wɔde nneɛma a Node.js hia regu so
stages.platform-sdks: Wɔde nkra dwumadibea SDKs regu so
stages.system-packages: Wɔde ripgrep ne ffmpeg regu so
stages.uv: Wɔde uv nneɛmapɔ sohwɛfo regu so

cards.body: Bue app no na ka nea wopɛ sɛ wɔyɛ no. OpenAmer yɛ adwuma wɔ akyi na ɛbɔ wo amanneɛ.
cards.title: Fa kasamu baako fi ase

cards.body: Nhyehyɛeɛ → Nkyerɛkyerɛ → Kasa. Kasa ne mpɔtam nhyehyɛeɛ 186, wubetumi asesa bere biara.
cards.title: Paw wo kasa

cards.body: Adwuma a ɛsan ba no bɛyɛ nimdeɛ — bere foforo no, ahyɛdeɛ baako pɛ na ɛhia.
cards.title: Ma ɛnkae

success.command: anaa fi ase akyiri yi wɔ ahyɛdeɛ mfɛnsere mu:
success.lead: Biribiara wɔ hɔ. Afei OpenAmer yɛ wo dea — wɔ afiri yi so, wɔ wo kasa mu.
success.title: OpenAmer ayɛ krado

bullets: Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ w'afiri so — wo nkɔmmɔ tena saa afiri yi so
Kasa 186, a atwerɛ a wokenkan ka ho
Wubetumi asesa biribiara akyiri yi; biribiara nni hɔ a ɛnsesa
welcome.lead: Wo ara wo boafo. Wɔ w'afiri so. Wɔ wo kasa mu.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer foforo ayɛ krado. Eyi si nea ɛwɔ hɔ kane no ananmu na ɛkora wo dwumadie ne nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa so.
welcome.note: Sɛ intanɛt no yɛ ntɛm sɛnea ɛsɛ a, ɛgye simma kakraa bi.
welcome.title: Akwaaba ba OpenAmer
